description.value:
Taking the offer doesn't touch the side you didn't pick. A bio-attuned Remade's Drift climbs exactly as fast as a first-timer's the day Cyber City's chrome goes in. A chrome-attuned Remade's Load and Resonance pile up exactly like anyone else's the day the Rendery starts cutting. Attunement is a discount at one counter — never a membership card good at both.

The Rendery and Cyber City each protect their own investment, and only their own. Neither has ever once covered the other's mistake, and a Remade who forgets that finds out the hard way which shop actually likes them.
